claims.claim: Every A9 packing can be normalized into an 1188×839 subrectangle of A0.
claims.evidence: For fixed labels and orientations, the feasible configuration space is compact: containment is closed and bounded, while pairwise non-overlap is a finite union of closed separation conditions. A minimizer of the sum of all x- and y-coordinates is therefore simultaneously left- and top-stable. If a rectangle at x>0 had no left blocker with positive vertical overlap, finite positive clearance would permit a leftward move, contradicting minimality. Following blockers strictly decreases x and terminates at x=0, so every right edge is a nonnegative sum of 52 and 37; the same argument applies to bottom edges. Exact enumeration gives maximum representable values 1188 and 839 under the respective container limits. Thus an equal-cardinality packing lies in [0,1188]×[0,839].
claims.witness: 1188=20·52+4·37, while 1189 would require the coefficient of 52 to be 25 modulo 37 and hence at least 25·52>1189. Likewise 839=14·52+3·37; 840 and 841 require respectively at least 19·52 and 24·52, both exceeding their totals.
claims.search_method: Reproved the compactness/stability argument and exhaustively enumerated all nonnegative 52/37 semigroup values up to 1189 and 841 using exact integers.

claims.claim: There is an explicit packing of 516 sheets.
claims.evidence: The three stated grids contain 60, 8, and 448 rectangles. Every rectangle has dimensions 52×37 or 37×52. Their occupied regions are respectively [0,1040]×[0,111], [1040,1188]×[0,104], and [0,1184]×[111,839], so they are contained in the reduced container and their interiors are mutually disjoint. Exact pairwise testing also finds no overlap.
claims.witness: The families (52i,37j;52,37), (1040+37i,52j;37,52), and (37i,111+52j;37,52), over the stated index ranges, have total cardinality 60+8+448=516.
claims.search_method: Generated all 516 rectangles from the formulas and checked dimensions, containment, cardinality, and every pair for strict interior overlap using integer comparisons.

claims.claim: No packing has 518 sheets; hence OPT≤517.
claims.evidence: After Claim 0, integer-cell weighting applies in the 1188×839 container. Marking cells with x+y≡50 mod 52 gives exactly 37 marked cells in either allowed rectangle orientation: one per row of a 52×37 rectangle or one per column of a 37×52 rectangle. Giving each mark weight 1/37 therefore assigns every sheet weight exactly one. The container has exactly 19162 marks, hence total weight 19162/37=517+33/37<518. Disjoint sheets cover disjoint unit cells, so their number is at most 517.
claims.witness: The exact marker decomposition is 52·22·16+44·16+7·22=19162. The 44×7 joint tail contributes zero because its residue sums range only from 0 through 49.
claims.search_method: Exhaustively checked both orientations for all 52² starting-residue pairs and directly counted all marked cells of the 1188×839 container.

claims.claim: Any hypothetical 517-packing must span a maximum reduced dimension and contain a prescribed blocking chain.
claims.evidence: In the simultaneous stable representative, maximum right and bottom coordinates are integers bounded by 1188 and 839. The rectangles have area 517·52·37=994708, but 1187·838=994706. Hence the packing cannot have both maximum right edge at most 1187 and maximum bottom edge at most 838; it reaches x=1188 or y=839. Stability then supplies a blocker chain from the extremal sheet to the corresponding boundary, and its widths or heights sum to that extremal dimension.
claims.witness: The unique nonnegative representation of 1188 is 20·52+4·37, and that of 839 is 14·52+3·37. Thus the applicable extremal chain has exactly those dimension counts.
claims.search_method: Checked the exact area comparison and exhaustively enumerated every nonnegative 52/37 representation of both extremal dimensions.

claims.claim: The natural horizontal 111+728 decomposition is exactly capped at 516.
claims.evidence: This is correct with the draft's explicit scope: rectangles must respect the fixed split. Area caps the 1188×111 band at floor(1188·111/(52·37))=68, attained by the first two grids. For a packing of N rectangles in the 1188×728 band, with n oriented 52×37, exact cross-section inequalities integrate to 259N+n≤98·1188 and 260N−n≤160·728. Adding yields 519N≤232904<519·449, so N≤448. A 32×14 grid of 37×52 rectangles attains 448. The two-band optimum is therefore 68+448=516; this does not constrain rectangles crossing the split.
claims.witness: Exact enumeration verifies 5p+7q≤98 whenever 37p+52q≤728 and 7p+5q≤160 whenever 52p+37q≤1188. Also 519·448≤232904<519·449.
claims.search_method: Enumerated all feasible nonnegative integer cross-section count pairs, checked both integrated inequalities, and checked the attaining grids exactly.

target_evidence: The draft rigorously supplies a 516-sheet placement and proves that 518 sheets are impossible, improving the source interval to 516≤OPT≤517. It neither constructs 517 sheets nor excludes every 517-packing, and explicitly acknowledges that gap. Therefore it makes material correct progress but does not determine the exact requested value. Its claimed resolution of PARTIAL is accurate.
